oracle.stack: Redis 8.8 (docker) + FT.HYBRID; fake 8-dim embeddings; grace 3600s; top_k 5; RRF k 60; cosine gate 0.30

scenarios.given: one memory m1 in oracle-brain; by-ID ops from other-brain
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: all cross-brain by-ID ops return the shared not_found shape

scenarios.given: two remember calls with identical topic/summary
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: duplicate remember is never an overwrite; both entries live

scenarios.given: five memories, importance 5..1, created at BASE
memory whose TTL has passed (Redis eviction)
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: expired rows never surface from get/recent

scenarios.given: importance-1 memory (7d TTL) reinforced 3 days later
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: reinforce re-arms the full importance TTL from now

scenarios.given: importance-5 memory forgotten, restored, forgotten, hard-deleted
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: forget clamps expiry to grace (never extends), hides from live reads; restore re-arms from importance; hard-delete is final

scenarios.given: three memories, two sharing one created timestamp

legacy.sort_key: period_start DESC (Redis SORTBY); ties by index order, no memory_id tie-break

scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: created_at DESC, memory_id ASC (locked deterministic tie-break)
scenarios.note: legacy has no stable tie-break for equal created timestamps; the clean contract adds memory_id ASC

scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: audit carries structural facts only, survives hard-delete, 90-day retention

scenarios.given: one memory with content+metadata; search/recent previews vs get
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: previews omit content/metadata; get returns full detail

scenarios.given: healthy stack, fake embedder not yet loaded
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: health never forces a model load; reports status/brain/agent/embedding state

scenarios.given: identifier exists only in content; doc vector orthogonal to query
scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: FIXED in clean branch: lexical-only candidates need no cosine floor; the content match IS returned
scenarios.note: this is the intentional ranking difference TASK-008 records

scenarios.expect_clean_equivalent: no lexical branch; vector-only retrieval, never an error
